gate: ER3 corpus dual lens (erlang) — full corpus INCLUDING include fragments, chunked, two independent implementations
method: Every `.erl` AND `.hrl` file in otp@de741b7, rebar3@3c1b417 and cowboy@c965d1a — all 4,617 of them, no stride sample. `.hrl` was added because the 291 include fragments are the heart of ER-D32's domain (a header with no `-module` at all), so the ruling that governs them most was the one ruling never verified by two implementations. Both lenses read the same parse tree: the analyzer, and a second implementation of the whole contract written from the language reference. 32 chunks, each a fresh process, because the WASM parser cannot survive a corpus in one.

macroModuleRemotes.meaning: a remote call or fun value whose MODULE is a macro names no derivable callee; only `?MODULE:f/1` does

wholeFileGrammarDamage.meaning: wx api_gen markup, OTP abstract-format `-record #r{}` and generated lexer tables yield nothing rather than edges recovered from error-recovery wreckage
